posts.topic_title: Rudie Berkhout Exhibition at the Holocenter
posts.author: Holocenter
posts.post_subject: Rudie Berkhout Exhibition at the Holocenter
posts.content_md:
Light Magic

holograms and laser works

Rudie Berkhout

April 18, 2009 through May 30, 2009

open Saturdays 12:00PM - 5:00PM

and by appointment

 :dance: **Opening: April 18, 2009 from 4:00PM - 7:00PM**

This retrospective exhibition showcases Rudie Berkhout's holograms and laser works to celebrate his life in art.

"My hope is to reach the subtler levels of perception, holding up mirrors for thoughts, that reflect the magic that surrounds us."

- Rudie Berkhout (1946 - 2008)

Center for the Holographic Arts

45-10 Court Square, Long Island City, NY 11101

p:: 718 784 5065 e:: [info@holocenter.org](mailto:info@holocenter.org)

[www.holocenter.org](http://www.holocenter.org)

This Exhibition is made possible with funds from the Decentralization Program, a regrant program of the New York State Council on the Arts, administered by the Queens Council on the Arts

posts.topic_title: Rudie Berkhout Exhibition at the Holocenter
posts.author: Kaveh
posts.post_subject: Rudie Berkhout Exhibition at the Holocenter
posts.content_md: Thanks for these photos. I need only look at Rudie's holograms, or even good pictures of them, once every few years to convince me that we are not wasting our time trying to pull holography back up. And we should all look at the pristine quality of the colors as an inspiration of what is possible with holography. Rest in peace Rudie.

posts.content_md: I wish I could see these holograms in person. What do the Study in light-holograms look like when you see them in 3D? How much depth do they have?
